reason: The hypothesis combines the well-documented thermodynamic ordering tendency (from P6, P7, P8, P9, P11, P12) with the kinetic control of phase selection (from P2, P3, P4, P14) into a single mechanistic framework, and applies it to a new, Cr-rich composition (Cr39Co18Fe18Ni18Al7) not directly studied in the cited passages. The proposed falsification test, which systematically varies cooling rates to probe the balance, is a logical extension but not explicitly stated in the earlier literature.
